text: the literary digestion. New York, September the 3rd. A man fell out of a 10-story window, landed in a soda water wagon, and didn't get hurt. He fell on some surf stuff. Ha ha! That's a good one, Jakey. Remember that and we'll tell it to your mother when we get home. Pitchfork, PA. Oliver August was killed in an explosion at 12 o'clock midnight, September the 4th. And that was the last of August. Chicago,
